verses.1: A message to the people of God: In your land, nations have covered your holy temple. They have made Jerusalem a ruin.
verses.2: We have given to your servants the food that will be eaten by the birds in the heavens, as a sustenance for their lives on earth.
verses.3: They poured their blood like water around Jerusalem, and no one could stop them.
verses.4: We were a source of shame for our neighbors, a source of ridicule and mockery for those around us.
verses.5: How long will Jehovah continue to torment us forever, like fire caused by your jealousy?
verses.6: Spread your heat upon those nations who do not know you, and upon those kings whose names you do not know.
verses.7: For I ate Yaakov and Navah.
verses.8: Do not remember our past mistakes. May your mercy come to us quickly, for we are very poor.
verses.9: Help us, O God of salvation! Save us through your name. Save us from our sins, so that we may honor your name.
verses.10: Why will the nations say, “These are our gods”? They should know that in our eyes, their bloodshed is an act of revenge for the blood of your servants.
verses.11: I will come before you as a prisoner, like your most noble descendant from the line of Tamuah.
verses.12: And let them sit beside us, seven in number, at their feet. For they have suffered the same disgrace that you have suffered, O Lord.
verses.13: We will be your people, and our sheep from your flock will be dedicated to you forever. Your songs will be sung for all time.
